C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear and the screenshot shows a till at once, but below the fold the home page switches to server internals that a newcomer who half-knows Vendure cannot follow: 'the Vendure plugin saves that id with the order in one step', 'settles it with two Admin API calls', 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12', 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)'.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 ('Every sale lands once' card), home.desktop.02 ('Live demo or your own store' refund row, 'Setting up the store' list)

C2.worst_defect: The one data-sharing disclosure names an unrelated, unexplained domain: 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com'. A newcomer sees 'wcpos', a brand the site never introduces, and wonders who that third party is.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline' / home.phone.04

C3.worst_defect: Before step 1, a 'Before a sale on a live store' warning sends the reader to two other pages (Set up email, Check your own code). Step 3 then has them create and run two new script files (src/generate-migration.ts, src/run-migrations.ts). So the path to the first sale has forks and stops that a 'quick' start doesn't suggest.

C4.worst_defect: The docs sidebar is one flat list of nine items that mixes developer setup (Plugin setup, Connect a till, Changelog) with cashier guides (At the till, Notifications), with no group headings, so a reader can't tell which pages are for them.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' puts two boxed cards with buttons above eight plain unboxed text items in a two-column grid. The section's style changes halfway, and the long grey-text feature list looks unfinished next to the polished hero.

C6.worst_defect: The phone hero screenshot is cropped to the product grid with only two product cards visible. The cart sits behind a 'Cart (3) · €20.09' tab, so the caption 'A sale in progress' shows no sale in progress.

C7.worst_defect: Docs pages carry only BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (no article or software-documentation type), and the 404 page has no search box, only Home/Docs/Live demo buttons. Both are minor next to Lighthouse 98/100/100/100.

overall_worst.defect: After a clear hero, the home page explains the product through server internals: 'saves that id with the order in one step', 'two Admin API calls', 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12', 'RXDB_PREMIUM'. A first-time visitor who only half knows what Vendure is gets setup detail instead of the plain reasons to try the demo.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.01-02 ('Every sale lands once' card, refund row of the comparison table, 'Setting up the store' list)
overall_worst.fix: Keep the home page's 'Before you start' and table cells to plain outcomes ('needs Vendure 3.6+ on Postgres'; 'refunds go through the Vendure Dashboard for now') and link to Limitations and Plugin setup for the Node range, the Admin API refund steps and the RxDB licence note.
